lines.text: I know him, not just know!
Many learners say: Do you know Ali? Yes, I know.
Better: Do you know Ali? Yes, I know him.

native.tip: Türkçede “Evet, tanıyorum.” deriz; İngilizcede “know” sonrası “him”, “her” veya “it” gerekir.

en.caption: Do you say “Do you know Ali? Yes, I know”? 😅 In English you cannot stop after know; you must say who or what. The right sentence is “Do you know Ali? Yes, I know him.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
